# Renewal Order Form 2026: Quarrendon Freight Lines

## 1. Parties and Preparation

This Renewal Order Form is entered into by Pemberline Systems and Quarrendon Freight Lines for renewal of Pemberline Dock, the yard and dock scheduling software. This instrument was drafted on 2026-03-02 and executed on 2026-03-20.

## 2. Effective Date

This Renewal Order Form takes effect on 2026-04-01. The execution date is distinct from the effective date and does not advance commencement of the renewal.

## 3. Commercial Terms

The price per seat per year is USD 1,920. A discount of 10% applies to that price. The resulting discounted price per seat per year is USD 1,728. The end of the current term (renewal date) is 2027-03-31.

## 4. Amendment of Earlier Agreement

This Renewal Order Form amends the earlier agreement between the parties solely with respect to the terms expressly set out herein. In the event of inconsistency concerning those terms, this Renewal Order Form controls. All other provisions of the earlier agreement remain unchanged.

## 5. Execution

**For Pemberline Systems**

Date signed: 2026-03-20

**For Quarrendon Freight Lines**

# Amendment No. 3 to the Quarrendon Master Subscription Agreement

**Drafted:** 2026-09-08

**Effective Date:** 2027-01-01

This Amendment No. 3 (“Amendment”) is entered into by Pemberline Systems (“Pemberline”) and Quarrendon Freight Lines (“Customer”). This Amendment modifies the earlier master subscription agreement between the parties, together with the applicable subscription paperwork previously entered into under that agreement (collectively, the “Agreement”), solely as set forth below.

## 2. Subscribed Seats

Effective 2027-01-01, Customer’s subscribed seat count for Pemberline Dock shall be **230 seats**.

This seat count supersedes any different subscribed seat count stated in the earlier Agreement or applicable subscription paperwork for the subscription addressed herein. The revised count shall govern from the Effective Date and shall not be construed as taking effect on the date of drafting or execution.

The parties execute this Amendment on 2026-09-22. Notwithstanding execution on that date, the change specified in Section 2 becomes effective only on 2027-01-01.

# North weekly 4/28

Happy Monday team! Hope everyone stayed dry over the weekend—it poured nonstop here from Friday evening right through Sunday afternoon, and my dog is currently refusing to step on the wet grass in the backyard, which made getting to my desk on time a fun little adventure. Anyway, grabbing my second coffee and dropping our quick rundown for the week of 28 Apr 2025 before we jump into the afternoon standup.

| Customer | Status | Operational Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Tamsin Cold Chain | Green | Kickoff completed 22 Apr 2025. Building out reefer door profiles for Tacoma. |
| Quarrendon Freight Lines | Green | MSA signed and live since 1 Apr 2025. Sorting out Gate 4 tablet issue. |
| Brackenwater Freight Co. | Yellow | Waiting on Dock 12-18 door schedule CSV from their Toledo yard lead. |
| Orrin Mills | Green | Quiet week, just tweaking the Detention Summary Report export columns. |

### Account Notes & Follow-ups

**Tamsin Cold Chain:** Huge shoutout on the kickoff call on 22 Apr 2025—it went really well! For the Northwest one Dana inherited, the cold storage supervisors were actually super prepared and brought a full spreadsheet of their carrier arrival windows and pre-cool buffer rules to the first session. Usually we have to chase people for two weeks just to get their shift handover times, so having their Tacoma night-shift lead walk us through how they stage refrigerated trailers on Doors 1 through 9 was a dream. We are setting up the temperature check prompts in Pemberline Dock this week and will do a quick sandbox walkthrough with their dispatchers on 1 May 2025.

**Quarrendon Freight Lines:** Just to make sure it is officially logged on the wiki page, the Quarrendon Freight Lines MSA is signed and live since 1 Apr 2025. # Private: Dana leave logistics

- 30 Jan 2026 — I need the HR loose ends done today, not sitting in my inbox over the weekend. Dana Okafor is on leave from 2 Feb 2026 to 13 Mar 2026. I’ll keep the leave paperwork separate from the North team handoff.

- Dana's benefits account needs her dependent added. I need to ask HR which portal step is still missing: dependent details, supporting document, or final submission. Don’t assume saving the form means it went through. Get the confirmation back to Dana before leave starts.

- Payroll qs for HR: does the leave entry cover the whole period, and does Dana need to submit anything separately? Also ask how any correction would show on her payslip. I don’t want to give her a guess based on the last leave request I dealt with.

- I’ll run the Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal while Dana is out. Today: collect the latest renewal thread, working document, and open questions. I need June Osei-Lark to point me to the current contracts copy so I’m not editing an old attachment.

- For Thea Ramaswell, I’ll keep renewal questions in one thread. Separate the Pemberline Dock issue about drivers arriving before their booked window; the yard team needs an answer on that without hunting through contract emails.

- Handoff checklist: where the weekly arrival report lives, which screenshots explain the early-arrival complaint, and whether the draft reply is still waiting on product input. Check the attachements actually open.

- Put a reminder on 13 Mar 2026 to review outstanding items, not to assume Dana is available that day. I’ll tidy the renewal notes as I go. Less backtracking later.

**Attendees:** Thea Ramaswell (Quarrendon Freight Lines), me

- Paperwork all squared away. New per-seat price is $1,920/yr.

# North weekly (Ilse covering)

**2026-02-09**  
Compiled from Ilse Varga’s team-lead notes for Ruth Calloway.

## Coverage during Dana’s leave

- Ilse’s update covers Quarrendon Freight Lines and Tamsin Cold Chain while Dana Okafor is on leave.
- Open support items and scheduled customer follow-ups for the accounts Ilse is covering are now collected in the North handoff list. Ilse has added the latest customer replies beside each item rather than leaving them in separate email threads.
- This week’s immediate work is appointment visibility, shift handoffs, and checking that saved reports match what dispatch teams see in Pemberline Dock.

## Quarrendon Freight Lines

- Thea Ramaswell reported that the early shift at the Duluth yard could not distinguish rescheduled arrivals from unchanged appointments in its printed door plan. Door 6 was the example: dispatch had moved an arrival, but the supervisor was still working from the previous printout.
- Ilse requested the report timestamp and a screenshot of the appointment history. Support ticket NORTH-241 records both examples.
- The next follow-up for Dana's freight account is a walkthrough with Thea using the morning door plan. Ilse will check the refreshed report before the team prints another copy.

## Tamsin Cold Chain

- The freezer receiving team flagged two appointments appearing under the same trailer reference in its afternoon queue. Ilse asked the shift coordinator to preserve both records until support checks the edit history.
- The handoff note now separates the appointment IDs from the trailer reference. This should make the next customer reply easier to follow.

## Equipment and next actions

- IT is reimaging Dana's laptop while she is out. The device is with the service desk.
- Ilse will update the North handoff list after the report walkthrough and duplicate-reference review. Remaining customer replies will be included in the next weekly.
